The Digital Atlas/Geoscape ward layer retains every original polygon part. Its live item says August 2026 while the service description says November 2025; later amendments and individual ward representation require separate reconciliation.

Dated official council roster snapshot checked 17 October 2026, independently of election results. Full original pages, contacts and biographies remain local-only. Individual profile URLs are retained where explicitly supplied; a roster link is labelled as such.

Published roster currently supplies four names, with no Milngin member listed. Do not infer an incumbent or a vacancy solely from that omission. The source describes Yvette Williams as deputy for a one-year term from 18 September 2025; that stated term has expired, so the role below is retained only as the published roster label and requires a fresh council appointment record.

Independent NTEC event page updated 24 August 2026 confirms the Milngin casual vacancy received zero nominations; a replacement election date was not yet announced. No current member is inferred for that ward.

30 October 2026: council confirms the Milngin Ward vacancy and replacement by-election being arranged. Its directly opened article has no confirmed timetable; conflicting indexed dates are excluded. No effective vacancy date or candidate is inferred.
